title.ja: エージェント実行と添付ファイルの修正
title.ko: 에이전트 실행 및 첨부 파일 수정

body.zh-TW: 統一代理執行路徑，並修正部分斜線命令消失、Vim 插入模式無法開啟背景任務，以及 Ogg 音訊與影片附件被拒絕的問題。
body.zh-CN: 统一代理执行路径，并修复部分斜线命令消失、Vim 插入模式无法打开后台任务，以及 Ogg 音频与视频附件被拒绝的问题。
body.en: Unifies the agent execution path and fixes missing slash commands, opening background tasks in Vim insert mode, and rejected Ogg audio/video attachments.
body.ja: エージェントの実行経路を統一し、スラッシュコマンドの消失、Vim 挿入モードでのバックグラウンドタスク操作、Ogg 添付の拒否を修正しました。
body.ko: 에이전트 실행 경로를 통합하고 슬래시 명령 누락, Vim 입력 모드의 백그라운드 작업 열기, Ogg 오디오/비디오 첨부 거부 문제를 수정했습니다.

items.original:
Improved the agent execution harness by consolidating onto a single execution path, giving more consistent tool, hook, and prompt behavior.
Fixed `/teamwork-preview` and some other slash commands disappearing for some users.
Fixed `Enter` not opening an active background task or subagent while the prompt was in Vim insert mode.
Fixed attaching Ogg audio and video files such as `.ogg`, `.opus` and `.ogv`, which the model rejected because they were sent as the generic `application/ogg`.
